meta.frame: u across the main door (its local +x), v into the room; W across, D deep. Anchors: L/R/F/B and a gap to that wall (F is the door wall), C and an offset from the middle, P and a share of the size from the middle
meta.pieces: f floor piece: name, u anchor, v anchor, yaw in the frame | m wall piece: name, u anchor, v anchor, height | h hung: name, u, v, yaw, height | c with a parent: name, parent index, local x, local z, turn, rise
meta.open: d door or w window, wall, middle along the wall from the wall middle, width
